dataset.name: Chandra Estates — property dataset
dataset.marketNote: The target market is India. These demo records still carry US-dollar prices and non-Indian neighbourhood names; they have not been localised in this stage.
dataset.dataDisclaimer: This file contains sample/demo data only. Nothing here is a real listing, a real address, a real price or a real availability. Do not present it to customers as available property.
dataset.currencyNote: Prices are the original demo values in US dollars. They have deliberately not been converted to INR — currency localisation is a separate step.
dataset.specsFormat: Array of [label, value] string pairs. Labels and units differ per category.
notes: IDs, image paths, titles, categories, locations, prices, featured flags, specifications and descriptions are copied unchanged from index.html.
No property in this dataset has a street address, city, PIN code, ownership record, approval, survey number or legal/RERA detail. None has been invented.
No sale/rent flag, availability status, amenities list, area unit, map location, video or listing date exists in the source data. Those fields are absent rather than guessed.
'added' is an internal sort key (days since listed) used for 'Newest' ordering; it is not shown on the website.
Photographs are stock images (Unsplash) referenced by relative path; property detail galleries additionally reuse shared interior photos across listings.
The website still reads the JavaScript array inside index.html. This file is a read-only export and is not yet referenced by the site.
